6 Each year, on her birthday, Ananya receives some money from each of her parents.
On Ananya’s first birthday, her father gives her $10. Every subsequent year, her father gives her $5
more than he gave her the previous year.
On Ananya’s first birthday, her mother also gives her $10. Every subsequent year, her mother gives her
20% more than she gave her the previous year.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Show that on Ananya’s eleventh birthday she receives more from her mother than from her father.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Find the total amount of money Ananya receives up to and including her eighteenth birthday.
